memoryBuilder.verseText: Be strong in the Lord and in His great power.

sequence.prompt: How did Paul's letter about God's armour come about? Put it in order.

items.label: Paul sat chained up in a prison
He looked at the soldier's armour
He wrote, 'Be strong in the Lord'
God's people put God's armour on and stood

matches.prompt: Match each part of the story to what it means.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: God's own armour, given to us
A day to stand, not to give up

application.question: Which hard day do you most need God's armour for?

options.label: When I am scared at night

application.followUp: Paul was chained to a soldier when he wrote this, so he was not pretending hard days are easy. He simply knew that God never sends His children out with nothing. Every piece of that armour is a gift, so you never have to be strong by yourself. Strong in the Lord.
